predictions.text: I predict that Timor-Leste will lift the suspension of in-person classes on October 17, 2026, but only in areas where air quality has improved to below 288 micrograms per cubic metre.

grade.line: No reports on Timor-Leste's schools came from 15 to 17 October. The 288 figure was Singapore's pollution reading, not a level set by Timor-Leste.
